test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pallavi walked from her college library, 70 m towards the north, then 60 m towards the West, then 45 m towards the north and then 60 m towards the East. She stopped at this point to buy some candies from a candy shop. She again walked 50 m towards the north. How far and in which direction is Pallavi's college library from the candy shop?
solution:
**Explanation:**

From the given information:

Step 1: Pallavi walked from her college library, 70 m towards the north, then 60 m towards the east.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f463c0bb30b0e3fc54908c3e85ed5b77c8da9092d15b1d398a68133e749b023.png] 

Step 2: Then 45 m towards the north and then 60 m towards the west.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6692b32363f6737dc425999e0b9ec391cb64947f8b9ca5533984e0a5ac2a645.png] 

Step 3: She stopped at this point to buy some candies from a candy shop. She again walked 50 m towards the north.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fc6dea7475a65695c61241b55f377fe2f2157c50c460d1d91823153aa6cecc3.png] 

Now we can see that the distance from candy shop to the starting point i.e library will be:

 **45m + 70m = 115m and the direction will be south.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 1.**
